svg.title: The summit in contours
svg.desc: Nested elevation lines tighten around one marked summit, with a consistent interval between levels.
svg.metadata: Mode: conceptual construction. Reference: P00. Five illustrative polar contours carry levels100,125,150,175,200. Radii28,50,74,98,122 with deterministic cosine/sine modulation and small center shifts. A plus marks the summit inside the200 contour. Each path deliberately stops around its text label; no masking patch hides linework. These are invented elevation units, not a surveyed location.
